Title: Tampa MF Vacancy 10.3%
Summary: Tampa multifamily vacancy 10.3% (well above national avg), 8,350 units delivered past year, only 6,300 absorbed, 10,000 more units in pipeline. Rents -1.9% YoY to $1,800/mo. New starts at multi-year low but damage done.
Diagnostic_Value: CRITICAL - SSB FL MF exposure faces vacancy pressure + incoming supply

Title: FL Net Migration Collapsed >90%
Summary: Census: FL net migration 2024-2025 = 22,517 (vs 300K-400K at peak). Demand source for FL housing exhausted. Migration narrative breaking.
Diagnostic_Value: HIGH - Removes demand tailwind; existing inventory harder to absorb

Title: Tampa Affordability Broken (5.4x income)
Summary: Tampa median income $74,475 vs ~$400K home price = 5.4x ratio. Sustainable is 3.0-3.5x. Implied fair value ~$250K (37% below current).
Diagnostic_Value: HIGH - Prices must fall or incomes rise; neither happening

Title: Tampa Hidden Inventory: 2,030 Deceased-Owner Properties
Summary: Property Radar: 2,030 properties in Tampa with deceased owners. Future inventory as estates settle. Low owner-occupancy = landlord class aging out.
Diagnostic_Value: MEDIUM - Shadow inventory will surface over 12-24 months

Title: FL Insurance Crisis Post-Hurricanes
Summary: Ian, Debby, Helene, Milton drove insurance premium spikes. Tampa historically had only 2 major hurricanes (1921, 1848) until 2024. "Luster reduced."
Diagnostic_Value: HIGH - Insurance costs compound affordability stress
